title: Following an omnibus test to pairwise checks
description: You can read the conditions that control the supplied statistical output.

steps.description: You generate the third sample and pass three samples to one-way ANOVA. The recording reports F equal to 5.64 and p equal to 0.0050.

steps.question: Does that recorded p value enter the follow-up block?
steps.answer: Yes. 0.0050 is below the code's 0.05 cutoff.

steps.description: The loop visits A versus B, A versus C and B versus C. Each call uses a two-sample t-test with equal_var set to False.
You add a star when a pair's p value is below 0.05 divided by three. The supplied output stars A versus B and B versus C, while A versus C has no star.
